emails.subject: November room packet closed
emails.body: Thanks for dropping off the sign-in clipboard and the borrowed name tags. I marked the November neighborhood room packet closed with no remaining setup items.

emails.subject: Pantry table brochure count complete
emails.body: We finished the leftover brochure count from the December pantry table: fourteen general bus-route brochures remained and were placed in the public rack. No further coordination is needed from the coalition.
